description.short: Open-source AI Operating System — start a session from any Teams chat.
description.full: Kortix is an open-source AI Operating System — your agents, skills, company memory, and connectors in one git repo you own. This app starts Kortix sessions from Microsoft Teams. Add the bot to a chat or channel, @-mention it with a task, and an agent gets on it — using your connected tools and replying right here as it goes, with live progress. Follow-ups stay in the same session. Managed by Kortix · https://kortix.com
